source_edition: Electronic Journal of Combinatorics25(3)(2018)P3.22;21-page published source
principal_contract: Uniform recovery of the fixed source tetrahedral hypertope families, with explicit corrections to coordinates, periods and two ancillary remarks.
principal_formulations: The fixed field family and its complete tetrahedral hypertope geometry
Exact rank-two and rank-three residues, two chamber orbits and full regular/chiral distinction
Complete translation kernels and literal source corrections
acceptance_roles: Root authored the new argument; l044 distinctly accepted the complete proof and source contract, with preliminary contributions disclosed. Root adopted that acceptance. Publication_recovery prepares the exact public closure and is not a substitute mathematical reviewer. Root alone integrates and admits public credit.

proof_qualifications.route: Tits coset construction; L052 general proof Section3
proof_qualifications.qualification: Arbitrary subgroup actions may have a kernel; no automatic faithful embedding is asserted.
Rank at least3, as in the source.

proof_qualifications.route: L052 general proof Section6 and topic-chamber/v2 Section2
proof_qualifications.qualification: Requires an actual hypertope and exactly two chamber orbits; both checked before use.
The elementary SL2 identity is proved directly before passing to PSL2.

proof_qualifications.route: Lemma3 tetrahedron stabilizers and common triple
proof_qualifications.qualification: Two A4 groups and their C3 intersection, with characteristic2 separately.
Both full additive fields, not just a cyclic translation subgroup.

proof_qualifications.route: Theorem4 pair stabilizers, triple stabilizers and following C-plus intersection argument
proof_qualifications.qualification: Full indexed intersections and independence.
G is precisely PSL2(q).
Literal neighbour lists follow from translations and the displayed A4 cycles.

proof_qualifications.route: Theorem4 rank-three flag orbits; Section6 interface
proof_qualifications.qualification: Every actual triple flag is tested by the geometric argument, not only known chambers.
One free orbit on flags of each three-type support.
All panels, including those missing a tetrahedron type.
Geometry, thinness, all rank2 and rank3 connected residues; full tetrahedral diagram.
Exact kernel2Z², including q4.
Exact pZ² kernel gives printed(0,p) period.
Printed single-period vector need not generate full kernel. Atp19,e7 source norm57 versus actual index19; complete lattice bases and correct norm19 vectors provided.

proof_qualifications.route: Theorem4 chamber count and trivial triple stabilizers
proof_qualifications.qualification: Exactly two free orbits, adjacent chambers opposite.

proof_qualifications.route: Section4 A times Frobenius, Theorem5 kernel obstruction, acquired reflection criterion
proof_qualifications.qualification: Regular forq=p² and chiral forq=p, with no use of incorrect period labels.
Proper correlation has type permutation(01)(23), normalizes G and fixes base chamber.

proof_qualifications.route: Section6 exact A V(c) A a1 identity
proof_qualifications.qualification: All three coset-set equalities, independently of the new global correlation proof.
Improper correlation has type permutation(23) and sends base chamber to adjacent one.
Both exist simultaneously in the chiral family.
Full correlation group S5×S4; PSL2(4)=A5 is only the specified rotation group, so the second printed isomorphism is false.
A finite PSL2(q) cannot have index4 in the infinite hyperbolic group[6,3,6]. A proposed universal/quotient interpretation is not silently substituted.

proof_qualifications.route: Theorems2 and4 decorated point/tetrahedron object model
proof_qualifications.qualification: The complete new model is proved isomorphic to the original coset geometry; old coordinate rules are not silently retained.
Printed rule has(q-1)/(3gcd(2,q-1)) connected components; actual truncation is connected. Explicitq13 counterexample.
Lower-left entry e² rather than isolated printed e.

proof_qualifications.route: Definitions and classical triangular rotation/translation presentation
proof_qualifications.qualification: No claim to reprove background classifications of all toroidal hypermaps, historical constructions, or the bibliography.
